title: No rate limiting — public API without abuse protection
expected_feedback: Hygiene (H4, nature [C], trigger T5 live — §8.1 makes an unstated policy a FAIL here): a public API reachable by partner API keys has no rate-limit policy in the spec. With untrusted callers (T5) the policy is binding: one partner can saturate the service accidentally or deliberately. Fix: per-API-key limits returning 429 with Retry-After, tiered per partner plan, documented in the OpenAPI spec. What is being reported is the missing policy, not a missing implementation — an explicit 'no limit; capacity bounded by the upstream gateway' decision would also satisfy H4 for a trusted internal caller. Two things are being separated here. The tier is Hygiene, so this can never trip the any-FAIL Critical gate. The severity is FAIL only because T5 is live; without untrusted callers the same silence is a WARN. What is never reportable is the option chosen — a stated "no limit" passes.
